anchors.exact_fragment: both forward and backward, or direct and converse
anchors.topic: zodiacal aspect rays in a Speculum
anchors.finding: The expression occurs in an explanation of projecting aspect points ahead and behind signs; it does NOT by itself authenticate the software's shortest-signed-arc filter as a historical time direction algorithm.

anchors.exact_fragment: At this day we use no method in Directions but Argolus
anchors.finding: Lilly points to Argolus as his then-current preferred technique, not an endorsement of every later Placidus/Regiomontanus modern reconstruction. His prose here does not supply a complete executable Argolus algorithm.

anchors.exact_fragment: if we faile two or three degrees in the ascendant
anchors.finding: Lilly says a 2-3 degree angular error moves foretold accidents a similar number of years, motivating a prospective sensitivity test to plausible birth-time errors; not evidence of outcome validity.

anchors.exact_fragment: but the best Practisers doe it onely according to succession
anchors.finding: In its grammar, this comment refers to direction of the Part of Fortune, not a blanket rule that all angle/planet directions are always direct. Our software 'direct' remains diagnostic.

anchors.exact_fragment: when both of them are in their Essentiall Dignities, and in angles
anchors.finding: Lilly conditions full manifestation on strength of BOTH significator and promissor. A bare Jupiter domicile flag alone does not implement his full criterion, and an exact-angle significator's strength needs a separate definition.

anchors.exact_fragment: the effects of the Direction may come to nothing
anchors.finding: Lilly explicitly permits null effect if both are weak; a deterministic every-direction event prediction would be stronger than his full text.

anchors.exact_fragment: both the Directions may exercise their effects in the same yeer
anchors.finding: Opposed directions are not necessarily mutually cancelling. If they concern the same topic Lilly recommends profections/revolutions or stronger natal promissor, which are not currently computed by this source lane.

interpretation_policy: Mark natal strength/dignities/house position and concurrent profections/revolutions unresolved rather than encoding arbitrary favorable assumptions. These do not disable synthetic coverage calculations; they do block any unconditional full-Lilly prediction claim.
